name: Lithoform Core
description: The Lithoform Core is an ancient kor orb, revealed to be a piece of Zendikar's soul made to undo damage, that Nahiri and Nissa fought over.

bio.text: Nahiri found the Core in the Murasa Skyclave and seized it despite Akiri's warnings, hoping to stabilize Zendikar and stop the Roil.

bio.text: She used it to destroy a Roil elemental, killing Zareth San in the blast and pushing Akiri off the ruin.

bio.text: At the Singing City Jace seized the Core with illusions, but Ashaya took it and handed it to Nissa.

bio.text: The Core told Nissa it was a piece of Zendikar made to undo damage, and she merged its power with her own, flattening the Singing City.

bio.text: Its power then healed Zendikar, reviving the elementals and making the Eldrazi wastes bloom.

status.text: The Lithoform Core is spent: Nissa discarded the inert Core after the healing and Jace found its power gone.

timeline.summary: Bala Ged becomes a home of nightmares and horrors and its Skyclave rises again; it slowly recovers after Nissa uses the Lithoform Core.
timeline.quote: After Nissa Revane 's use of the healing power of the Lithoform Core , the continent slowly recovers.

citation.text: "Bala Ged", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri unleashes the Lithoform Core, wiping out the elemental in a white blast and turning everything ashen gray.
timeline.quote: the elemental was completely gone

citation.work: Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall
citation.text: "Episode 3: The Dangerous Climb, the Long Fall" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri takes the lithoform core, calming the Roil but killing the fern elemental; they fight and Nissa planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Nissa chose to protect Zendikar alone and planeswalked away

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Murasa skyclave Nahiri finds the Core, kills Zareth using it, and petrifies Akiri and pushes her over a cliff.
timeline.quote: Using the artifact to defend herself, Nahiri killed Zareth in the process.

citation.text: "Lithoform Core", section "Finding the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa and her elementals have destroyed the focal point and attack Jace and Nahiri; Jace takes control of Nahiri's mind and the Core, but Ashaya takes it and hands it to Nissa.
timeline.quote: he was caught by Ashaya who took the Core and handed it to Nissa herself.

citation.text: "Lithoform Core", section "The Singing City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa learns the Core is a piece of Zendikar's soul and uses its power against Nahiri's hedrons; the Singing City and part of the forest are flattened.
timeline.quote: The Singing City was gone.

citation.text: "Lithoform Core", section "The Singing City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zendikar begins healing and Nissa flies home to Bala Ged; Jace finds the Core's power gone.
timeline.quote: As Jace picked up the Lithoform Core, he found that its power was gone.

citation.text: "Lithoform Core", section "The Singing City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri seizes the Core despite Akiri's warnings, destabilizing the ruin.
timeline.quote: Nahiri seized it despite Akiri's warnings

citation.text: "Murasa Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri uses the Core to destroy a Roil elemental, killing Zareth.
timeline.quote: Zareth was killed when Nahiri used the Core's power to destroy the elemental

citation.text: "Murasa Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri hires adventurers and uses the Lithoform Core, killing Zareth and pushing Akiri off the ruin.
timeline.quote: Nahiri used the artifact to defend herself but killed Zareth in the process.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa uses the Lithoform Core to heal Zendikar and restore its wild nature, and Nahiri swears revenge on Jace.
timeline.quote: Nissa had used the power of the Lithoform Core to heal the damage done by the Eldrazi and restore Zendikar's wild nature

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa uses the Lithoform Core, which levels the Singing City and then heals Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Singing City was gone.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes the Core has undone the damage and Zendikar is healing.
timeline.quote: It had undone the damage to the plane.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane uses the Lithoform Core's healing power, accelerating the continent's recovery.
timeline.quote: the recovery of the continent was accelerated

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Nissa clash over how to end the Roil, and Nissa prevails, restoring Zendikar with the Lithoform Core.
timeline.quote: In the end, Nissa Revane prevailed, and restored the soil and wild nature of Zendikar by use of the Lithoform Core .

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa speaks mind-to-mind with Jace while the Core's voice, which is Zendikar itself, speaks to her.
timeline.quote: I am me. I am you.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa merges her magic with the Core, colliding with Nahiri's hedrons and flattening the Singing City.
timeline.quote: Nissa's magic merged with the Core's power.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The Core's power heals Zendikar, reviving the elementals and making the Eldrazi wastes bloom.
timeline.quote: Zendikar was healing, turning into something healthier, stronger than it was before the battle with the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Jace and Akiri travel to the Singing City seeking Nahiri and the Lithoform Core; Jace escapes the maddening music with a sound-blocking spell.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren and Akiri traveled to the city in search of Nahiri

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace infiltrates the city, traps Nahiri's mind with a psychic illusion and seizes the Core, but Ashaya takes it and gives it to Nissa.
timeline.quote: he trapped her mind with a psychic illusion and seized the Core

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Core tells Nissa telepathically that it is a piece of Zendikar created to undo damage.
timeline.quote: revealing that it was a piece of Zendikar and was created to undo damage

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace tries to seize control of Nissa's mind and Ashaya restrains him; Nissa merges the Core's power with her own as Nahiri attacks.
timeline.quote: Nissa tapped into the Core's power and merged it with her own, unleashing a powerful burst of energy.

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The explosion destroys the Singing City; Zendikar begins visibly healing and Nissa discards the Core and departs.
timeline.quote: The explosion destroyed the Singing City

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri used the Core and killed Zareth San in the blast.
timeline.quote: which also killed Zareth San in the blast

citation.text: "Akiri", section "Sea Gate Expeditionary House". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri discovers the Lithoform Core in the Murasa Skyclave and travels to the Singing City to use it.
timeline.quote: was discovered by Nahiri in the Murasa Skyclave

citation.text: "Healing of Zendikar", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri plans to stabilize Zendikar with the Core, but Nissa opposes her.
timeline.quote: Her plan was opposed by Nissa Revane

citation.text: "Healing of Zendikar", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa destroys the leyline focal point Nahiri intended to use; conflict escalates and Jace seizes the Core with illusions before Ashaya returns it to Nissa.
timeline.quote: Ashaya intervened and returned the Core to Nissa.

citation.text: "Healing of Zendikar", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Core reveals it was born from Zendikar, and Nissa merges it with her elemental connection, channeling its power through herself and Ashaya.
timeline.quote: Nissa allowed the Core to merge with her elemental connection

citation.text: "Healing of Zendikar", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa discards the inert Core and departs; Nahiri, furious, planeswalks away; Jace stays to witness the recovery.
timeline.quote: Nahiri, furious at her failure and Jace's perceived betrayal, planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Healing of Zendikar", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sought to destroy the Roil, clashing with Nissa Revane, who prevailed and restored Zendikar with the Lithoform Core.
timeline.quote: In the end, Nissa Revane prevailed

citation.text: "Roil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Nissa Revane uses the Lithoform Core's healing power, the continent slowly recovers.
timeline.quote: the continent slowly recovers

citation.text: "Sejiri", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa uses the Lithoform Core's healing power and the vale begins to recover.
timeline.quote: the vale and the rest of the continent slowly started to recover

citation.text: "Tangled Vale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
